content:
Priya S: @channel quick sync — AcmeHealth just flagged a regression: p99 embeddings latency spiked ~3x from our Dedicated pool #3 around 10:12 PDT. They said SLA clauses could trigger if this persists. We need a short-term workaround + owners for a hotpatch. Who can own?

Devon H: on it. digging into autoscale/pool3 logs now. my hunch: batch sizing change + a bad kernel fallback. Will confirm.

Kevin L: tagging eng-sre: if pool3 is saturated we can temporarily route AcmeHealth to pool1 (lower load) and attach burst quota. I can flip routing policy for their customer-id. Need a quick {{customer_id}} — Priya? :eyes:

Priya S: AcmeHealth customer_id is acct-acme-918. They agreed to short redirection to avoid SLA breach for 1-2 hours.

Devon H: confirmed anomaly in kernel selection path — some requests are falling back to fp32 path due to quant table mismatch. I have a repro locally. Plan: push a small hotpatch that forces the alternate quant table selection and add a metric check to avoid the fallback.

Maria G: milestone check — what's the ETA for a hotpatch build, canary, and full rollout? We need to tell CS an ETA for the workaround + code fix.

Devon H: ETA: 30 min to open PR, 45 min to run canary (5% traffic for 10m), 90 min full rollout if green. That assumes no infra blockers. I'll include a rollback flag.

QA Jenny: I can run a focused regression suite on the canary. Need the repo + PR. Also will validate p99 under simulated load.

Devon H: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4821 — short description: force-quant-table-fallback-guard. Commit: d4c3b9f. CI passed unit tests, integration pending.

Oncall Bot: [ALERT] route-change requested by Kevin L for acct-acme-918. Action: prepare routing override.

Kevin L: I'll stage the routing override now. Command (will run):
```
redwoodctl routing override set --customer acct-acme-918 --target-pool pool1 --ttl 3600 --reason "p99 spike, temporary"
```
I will post back once applied.

Devon H: pinging @eng-platform-owners for code review on PR 4821: quick look appreciated, especially runtime selection bits.

Maria G: CS wants an ETA to tell the customer. Based on this thread: immediate routing override now (Kevin), PR + canary within 45 min (Devon), QA validation window 10m (Jenny). Please confirm to compose message.

Priya S: Confirmed. I'll message CS with that timeline and note rollback plan.

Kevin L: Routing override applied at 10:27 PDT. Verified traffic for acct-acme-918 now on pool1. Monitoring p99.

Devon H: Canaries started at 10:38 PDT at 5% traffic. Initial traces show latency back to baseline. Continuing 10m.

QA Jenny: Running stress harness now. Sending logs in thread. Early numbers look good — p99 within SLA. Will post full report in 8m.

Jira Bot: Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7352 (AcmeHealth dedicated p99 regression). Link in PR description.

Devon H: Canary looks good. Rolling to 50% then 100% over next 30m. Rollback flag enabled: --rollback-on-p99>2x for 5m.

Kevin L: I'll keep the routing override in place for 1h to make sure customer sees improved metrics, then remove once stable.

Maria G: Ownership summary for execs: Devon H (hotpatch PR + rollout), Kevin L (routing override + monitoring), QA Jenny (canary validation), Priya S (customer comms). Timeline: routing now, PR/canary within 45m, full rollout ~90m.

Priya S: Sending CS update now. Thank you everyone. :heart:

Devon H: after rollout I'll open follow-up to track a permanent fix (INF-7353) to prevent similar quant fallback on new model variants.

QA Jenny: Full canary report: p99 pre=1.4s, during override=0.42s, post-patch canary=0.4s. No functional regressions detected in targeted suite.

Oncall Bot: [RESOLVE] alert INF-7352 route-change resolved (routing override active).

Priya S: Closing loop — CS confirmed metrics improved and won't escalate for now. Leaving Jira ticket INF-7352 open for postmortem and INF-7353 for permanent fix. Thanks all.
